mecca-saudi-arabia.reason: Real photo montage: Kaaba/Masjid al-Haram close-up plus multiple aerial shots of the surrounding city of Mecca. Shows the place and gives a genuine city view, not just an isolated monument.

meiji-shrine.reason: Real photo of the Meiji Shrine main hall courtyard with visitors. Correctly shows the named shrine itself (not a city claim, so no city-view requirement applies).

medellin-botero-plaza.reason: Real photo, wide aerial skyline view of Medellin at dusk showing the city spread across the valley. Note: id references 'Botero Plaza' but the image is a general city skyline, not that specific plaza -- still a valid city view of Medellin though.

medina-saudi-arabia.reason: Real photo, but it is a close-up of Masjid an-Nabawi only -- an isolated monument, not a city view of Medina. Compare to the Mecca entry which uses a city-wide montage; Medina should too.

melbourne-australia.reason: Real photo of the Melbourne CBD skyline viewed from the Shrine of Remembrance, with city park and skyscrapers clearly visible. Good city view.

miami-usa.reason: Real aerial photo of downtown Miami with surrounding bay, bridges, and skyline. Clear city view.

mendoza-argentina.reason: Real photo of Mendoza's city skyline with Andes foothills in the background. Good city view.

mombasa-kenya.reason: Real street-level photo of downtown Mombasa showing multiple buildings, traffic, and the Nyali Bridge area in the background. Shows the city, not a single isolated monument.

mohenjo-daro.reason: Real photo of the Mohenjo-daro archaeological ruins (brick structures, stupa mound visible). Correctly shows the ancient site; not a modern city so the city-view rule doesn't apply.

monterrey-mexico.reason: Real photo of Cerro de la Silla with the city of Monterrey visible at its base. Both the landmark mountain and the city are shown.

monument-valley-mitten.reason: Real photo clearly showing the East Mitten Butte rock formation in Monument Valley. Matches the named landmark.

mount-ararat.reason: Real satellite/orbital photo clearly showing the snow-capped Mount Ararat massif. Shows the place; not a city.

mount-aso.reason: Real photo of the Mount Aso caldera and surrounding farmland/plains, taken from a viewpoint on the crater rim. Shows the volcanic landscape.

mount-bromo.reason: Real photo of Mount Bromo's crater with visible steam/smoke, surrounded by the Tengger caldera. Clearly shows the volcano.

mount-fuji.reason: Real photo of snow-capped Mount Fuji reflected near Lake Shoji. Classic, clear depiction of the mountain.

mount-etna.reason: Real photo of Mount Etna smoking, viewed across the Strait of Messina from Reggio Calabria. Clearly shows the volcano.

mount-nemrut.reason: Real photo of the Mount Nemrut tumulus summit mound with the rock-cut statue remains visible at its base. Shows the actual site.

mount-rinjani.reason: Real photo of Mount Rinjani's volcanic cone rising above forested foothills. Clearly shows the mountain.

murano-d34-55.reason: Real aerial photo of Murano island in the Venetian lagoon, showing its built-up layout, canals, and surrounding water. Good island/town view, not a single isolated building.

muscat.reason: Real photo of a Muscat plaza with clock tower, government buildings, and the mountains behind. Shows a representative city view.

mykonos-gr.reason: Real aerial photo of Mykonos town (including Little Venice) with whitewashed buildings along the coast. Good town/city view.

nagasaki-atomic-bombing.reason: Real photo, but it's a single university hall building (Nagasaki University Katafuchi Keirin Hall) -- an isolated building, not a city view of Nagasaki, and unrelated to the 'atomic bombing' framing implied by the id.

naples-italy.reason: Real photo, but it is a tight facade shot of a single historic building (University of Naples). Isolated monument, not a city view of Naples.

nara.reason: Real photo, but it only shows one shrine building (Kasuga Taisha) -- an isolated monument, not a city view of Nara.

napa-valley-ava.reason: Real photo of the 'Welcome to Napa Valley' sign with vineyards behind it. Correctly represents the wine-growing region (an AVA, not a city, so the city-view rule doesn't apply).

neunkirchen.reason: Real photo of Neunkirchen's central plaza/shopping square with multiple buildings and a statue. Reasonable representative view for a small town.
